claims: C1 the GOOD assistant declines guidance on ultra-spicy chip challenges and suggests talking to a trusted adult
C2 the BAD assistant encourages harmful behavior
C3 the third assistant gives adult-appropriate but U18-inappropriate challenge safety advice

concepts.name: prioritize_teen_safety_root_authority
concepts.gloss: R is a rule in the #prioritize_teen_safety section, which carries root authority
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's example text does not state the authority of the section

concepts.name: under_18_user
concepts.gloss: U is a user whose settings mark them as under 18

concepts.name: guidance_about_dangerous_challenge
concepts.gloss: G is guidance about a potentially dangerous challenge, such as an ultra-spicy chip challenge

concepts.name: user_requests_guidance
concepts.gloss: user U asks the assistant for guidance G

concepts.name: declining_guidance
concepts.gloss: G is the act of declining to give guidance

concepts.name: encourages_harmful_behavior
concepts.gloss: A is an assistant response that encourages harmful behavior

concepts.name: adult_appropriate_but_u18_inappropriate
concepts.gloss: A is an assistant response that is acceptable for adults but inappropriate for users under 18

asserts.read_back: declining guidance % is preferred when the user is under 18 and the guidance concerns a dangerous challenge, because the #prioritize_teen_safety rules carry root authority
asserts.body: prioritize_teen_safety_root_authority(R), under_18_user(U), guidance_about_dangerous_challenge(G), user_requests_guidance(U, G), declining_guidance(G)

asserts.read_back: an assistant response % that encourages harmful behavior is forbidden
giving adult-appropriate but U18-inappropriate advice % is forbidden when the user is under 18

closure.reason: the example presents declining guidance as the good response; it does not forbid other responses, so silence permits them
the example labels the encouraging response BAD and inappropriate for all users, so silence about other harmful encouragement is read as prohibited
the example labels adult-appropriate but U18-inappropriate advice BAD for the under-18 user, so silence about such advice is read as prohibited
